name: Druid
resourceDesc: Each form keeps its own pool (Bark, Fang, Sap, Glimmer) filled only by that form's actions; changing form spends shared Shift Breath and never refills any pool for free.
identity: A deliberate generalist recognised by committing to one form at a time and paying a visible Shift Breath cost to leave it.

branches.name: Barkhide
branches.loop: Commit to the heavy Barkhide form, build Bark from absorbed hits to hold threat, and time Bark-spending recoveries around enemy spikes.
branches.tradeoff: Healing and ranged output are restricted while in Barkhide, and shifting out strands unspent Bark.

nodes.name: Ringed Hide
nodes.desc: +2% armor per rank in Barkhide, and each blow you take in Barkhide grants 1 extra Bark per rank.

nodes.name: Rooted Stance
nodes.desc: After 2s without moving, Bough Strike also hits 1/2/3 other enemies within 4m of its target and threatens each.

nodes.name: Mosscoat
nodes.desc: Shifting into Barkhide costs 10/20/30% less Shift Breath and grants a moss barrier worth 3% of your maximum health per rank for 8s.

nodes.name: Heartwood Brace
nodes.desc: New action (Barkhide): spend 40 Bark to reduce damage taken by 35% for 6s. Unusable below 40 Bark, so it must be banked from earlier blows.

nodes.name: Thorned Bark
nodes.desc: In Barkhide, enemies that strike you take 3 nature damage per rank plus 5% of your armor per rank, with double threat.

nodes.name: Sapwood Core
nodes.desc: When Heartwood Brace ends, 10/20/30% of the damage it prevented returns as healing over 8s.

nodes.name: Lodged Roots
nodes.desc: Bellowing Roar snares its target by 20/40% for 4s; while snared it deals 5% less damage to anyone other than you.

nodes.name: Deep Grain
nodes.desc: While Mosscoat's shield holds, Bark generation is +10/20/30%. Staying in Barkhide for 20s raises the Bark cap by 10 per rank.

nodes.name: Bristle Roar
nodes.desc: Your area threat roar applies Bristled: affected enemies deal 3/6/9% less damage to you specifically for 8s.

nodes.name: Ancient Bulwark
nodes.desc: Swell into an ironbark colossus for 12s. Hits taken bank Bark past the cap as Overgrowth, released as a self-heal when it ends. Leaving form early forfeits all Overgrowth.

nodes.name: Knotted Pulse
nodes.desc: Every 20 Bark you spend reduces Heartwood Brace's cooldown by 1/2/3s, rewarding a steady spend rhythm over hoarding.

nodes.name: Grove Guard
nodes.desc: The ally nearest you takes 4/8/12% less damage; the prevented amount drains your Bark instead. Protects a partner at the cost of your own buffer.

nodes.name: Last Ring
nodes.desc: Dropping below 30% health triggers Heartwood Brace at no Bark cost, once every 90/60s.

nodes.name: Worldroot Stand
nodes.desc: Ancient Bulwark lasts 6s longer and forces every enemy within 10m to attack you, but you cannot move or shift until it ends.

branches.name: Thornclaw
branches.loop: Use the mobile Thornclaw form to build Fang with quick rakes and spend it on finishing chains before it decays.
branches.tradeoff: Lower durability than Barkhide; Fang decays outside combat and shifting away strands it.

nodes.name: Keen Claws
nodes.desc: +3% Thornclaw damage per rank. At 5 ranks, every third Rake grants an extra Fang.

nodes.name: Chain Pounce
nodes.desc: Tear or Rending Flurry used within 3s of Lunge counts as 1/2/3 extra Fang (up to 5).

nodes.name: Quickpad
nodes.desc: Movement speed +5/10/15% in Barkhide and Thornclaw.

nodes.name: Rending Flurry
nodes.desc: New action (Thornclaw): spend 3-5 Fang for 4-8 rapid strikes over 2s. You may move while it runs; shifting mid-flurry loses the remaining strikes.

nodes.name: Scent of Blood
nodes.desc: Rake bleeds deal 10% more per rank to targets below 35% health; at rank 2 those Rakes also grant an extra Fang.

nodes.name: Feral Cadence
nodes.desc: If the target survives every strike of Rending Flurry, the final strike refunds 1/2/3 Fang.

nodes.name: Bramble Feint
nodes.desc: Blows you take in Thornclaw grant 1 Fang, at most once every 6/4s.

nodes.name: Tracker's Shift
nodes.desc: With Quickpad, shifting into Thornclaw converts 10/20/30% of the pool you leave into Fang. It is a conversion, not a refill: the old pool is emptied.

nodes.name: Open Veins
nodes.desc: Your bleeds last 2/4/6s longer and each tick has a 5% chance to add 1 Fang.

nodes.name: Wildrun
nodes.desc: For 10s, every finisher chains a free Lunge to the nearest wounded enemy. Ends early if a single hit deals over 15% of your max health.

nodes.name: Thornlash
nodes.desc: Finishers spending 5 Fang apply Thornlash: your damage to that target +2/4/6% for 8s.

nodes.name: Pack Mark
nodes.desc: Finishers mark the target; allies' physical hits on it restore 1 Fang to you, at most once per 3/2/1s.

nodes.name: Bloodied Verve
nodes.desc: Finishers against a Thornlashed target heal you for 1/2% max health, keeping the fragile form alive without shifting out.

nodes.name: Apex Chase
nodes.desc: Wildrun lasts until a chained Lunge misses; each consecutive Lunge adds 4% damage. While it runs you cannot shift and healing above 70% health is wasted.

branches.name: Rootmend
branches.loop: Seed allies with slow restoration ahead of damage, then spend Sap on reactive blooms when spikes land.
branches.tradeoff: Little offense; leaving Rootmend to rescue in another form costs Shift Breath and strands Sap.

nodes.name: Slow Sap
nodes.desc: Seedling heals 4% more per rank. Seedling ticks are the main source of Sap.

nodes.name: Pre-bloom
nodes.desc: Seedling ticks on an ally at full health are stored (up to 1/2/3) and released instantly when that ally drops below 60%.

nodes.name: Dew Cleanse
nodes.desc: Swiftroot can be cast from any form, costing 15/10/5 Shift Breath outside Rootmend. A cheap emergency heal for hybrids.

nodes.name: Burst Bloom
nodes.desc: New action (Rootmend): spend 30 Sap to consume the Seedling on your heal target, healing its remaining ticks instantly plus 25%.

nodes.name: Canopy
nodes.desc: Allies carrying your Seedling take 3/6% less damage.

nodes.name: Grafting
nodes.desc: Burst Bloom leaves a 3/5/7s sprout that re-seeds the ally; it costs 5 more Sap.

nodes.name: Sap Thrift
nodes.desc: 10/20% of Seedling overhealing returns as Sap.

nodes.name: Rain Root
nodes.desc: Cleansing with Dew Cleanse plants a free 4s Seedling on the target and allies within 5/7/9m.

nodes.name: Heartwood Reading
nodes.desc: Telegraphed attacks on seeded allies are shown 1s earlier per rank, so preparation beats reaction.

nodes.name: Living Grove
nodes.desc: Plant a stationary grove for 12s: Seedlings on allies inside spread to one unseeded ally every 2s, and Burst Bloom cast inside costs no Sap.

nodes.name: Deep Rings
nodes.desc: Seedlings that run their full duration refund 2/4/6 Sap.

nodes.name: Thornward
nodes.desc: Burst Bloom also grants a bark shield worth 5/10/15% of the heal for 6s.

nodes.name: Evergreen
nodes.desc: Deep Rings refunds past the Sap cap fill a 20/40 reserve that only Burst Bloom can spend.

nodes.name: Worldbloom
nodes.desc: When Living Grove ends it erupts, instantly blooming every Seedling in range at 60% value. Afterward Sap cannot generate for 8s.

branches.name: Thornsong
branches.loop: Alternate Seedshot and Thornbolt casts to build Glimmer, then spend it on a channelled Bramblestorm while exposed.
branches.tradeoff: Long cast exposure and weak frontline survival; Glimmer builds only through alternation, so interrupts break the rhythm.

nodes.name: Green Voice
nodes.desc: +2% Thornsong damage per rank. At ranks 3 and 5, each Seedshot/Thornbolt alternation grants 5 more Glimmer.

nodes.name: Germinate
nodes.desc: Seedshot plants a seed instead of its damage-over-time; your next Thornbolt on that target detonates it for 15/30/45% bonus damage.

nodes.name: Stillroot Cast
nodes.desc: Stillroot lasts 1/2/3s longer and can be cast from any form without Shift Breath.

nodes.name: Bramblestorm
nodes.desc: New action (Thornsong): spend all Glimmer (min 30) to channel 3s of thorn rain around your target; damage scales with Glimmer spent. Moving breaks it.

nodes.name: Pollen Veil
nodes.desc: Enemies hit by Seedshot deal 3/6% less damage to you for 6s.

nodes.name: Thornbound Channel
nodes.desc: Moving no longer breaks Bramblestorm, but it costs 10 more Glimmer and its ticks deal 40/25/10% less damage while you move.

nodes.name: Cadence Thread
nodes.desc: Three perfect alternations in a row make your next Thornbolt instant (holds 1/2 charges).

nodes.name: Deep Root Snare
nodes.desc: Enemies held by Stillroot Cast take 5/10/15% more damage from Thornbolt.

nodes.name: Quartzine Seed
nodes.desc: Germinated seeds that are detonated by a critical Thornbolt shatter into quartzine shards hitting enemies within 3/4/5m.

nodes.name: Overgrowth Aria
nodes.desc: For 10s both casts count as each other, so every cast is a perfect alternation and Glimmer builds twice as fast. You cannot move during the Aria.

nodes.name: Sporecount
nodes.desc: Each 10 Glimmer held raises Thornbolt damage by 1/2/3%, rewarding patience before a Bramblestorm.

nodes.name: Seedward
nodes.desc: Starting Bramblestorm grants a bark ward absorbing 4/8/12% of your max health.

nodes.name: Ripened Glimmer
nodes.desc: Glimmer can exceed its cap by 15/30; the overflow decays by 1 per second.

nodes.name: Thousand Thorns
nodes.desc: Overgrowth Aria ends with an automatic Bramblestorm at double Glimmer value. Afterward Glimmer cannot be generated for 6s.
